data.display_address: Creek Crescent, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience luxury waterfront living in this spacious 3-bedroom apartment with a maid’s room in Creek Crescent Tower, located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour.

This beautifully designed apartment offers a perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and breathtaking creek views. With floor-to-ceiling windows, the home is filled with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout. The expansive balcony provides stunning water views, ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

Property Features:

-3 Spacious Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
-4 Modern Bathrooms
-Large Living & Dining Area
-Fully Fitted Kitchen with Premium Finishes
-Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
-Expansive Balcony with Creek Views
-2 Covered Parking Spaces

Residents of Creek Crescent enjoy world-class amenities and a vibrant waterfront lifestyle. The building offers direct access to the scenic creekside promenade, perfect for walking, cycling, and outdoor leisure.

Community & Amenities:

-Temperature-Controlled Swimming Pool
-Fully Equipped Gymnasium
-Children’s Play Area
-Direct Access to Creekside Park & Promenade
-24/7 Security and Concierge Services
-Covered Parking

Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport, this property offers unmatched connectivity while maintaining a serene waterfront lifestyle.

Ideal for both end-users and investors seeking high ROI in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.
